in_hebrew.name: עליס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור השם בעברית 'עליס' יצא מאלכסנדריה שבמצרים, ומשמעותו היא חיים ואושר. בעברית, 'עליס' הוא שם נשי, והוא מצוי בטקסטים שונים בספרות העברית. בנוסף למשמעותו הפשוטה, 'עליס' גם יכול לסמל חיים ארוכים ואושר גדול. במסורת היהודית, 'עליס' נחשב לשם נשי אופטימי, המייצגת את האושר האמיתי.

in_greek.name: Ἀλύς

in_latin.name: Alys
in_latin.long_meaning: Origine Alexandriae, nomen Alys significat vitam et felicitatem. In traditione Christiana, nomen Alys est significans vitam et felicitatem. In cultura Latina, nomen Alys est utilis in scriptis et in conversatione.

data.cultural_impact: Alys, as a Welsh derivative of Alice, is a name steeped in history and culture. The name holds a significant presence in both ancient Celtic and Christian traditions. Historically, the Welsh name Alys symbolizes the kind and helpful nature of an individual, reflecting the values of compassion and empathy. The name has been featured in various works of literature and art, such as the popular 19th-century Welsh poet, Thomas Rowlands-Green, in his poem "The Vision of Alys".
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Alys carries inherent qualities attributed to Alice, making it a powerful and meaningful moniker. As a variant of Alice, Alys holds connotations of nobility, delicacy, and holiness. Additionally, Alys can be associated with St. Alice of Schaumburg, a German noblewoman and Franciscan tertiary, who was renowned for her virtue, piety, and charity. Alys, therefore, represents the ideal of a generous, compassionate, and devoted soul.
